note: anvil #0 (in the default Lens) places spam.txt at anvil #6's address; #6 (the wallet) adds notes/ there, blocks spam.txt, then unblocks it.
steps: Open the realm root; connect as anvil #6
New folder at your own address: no notice; it shows as the owner's
Block spam.txt (#0's) at your own address: the review says what a block does
Send: spam.txt is gone for you; the notice offers Unblock
Unblock: one send; #0's spam.txt shows at your address again
